name: Archive Status
description: Extractions in the notch: how far they are, the speed or the time left, then Show in Finder and Open. Several at once share one card. For MacPacker, The Unarchiver, Keka and Archive Utility. No permission needed.

settings.title: File-Type Icons
settings.description: Show the archive's type (zip, rar, 7z…) in the pill. Off: the pill keeps the archive box. Several extractions always show their number.

settings.title: Extraction Details
settings.description: What follows the amount while extracting: the speed, the time left, or both, taking turns every 3 seconds.

settings.title: Delayed Display
settings.description: While you're away, extractions that end don't open the notch. Their card opens when you're back.

settings.title: Away After
settings.description: You count as away when the screen is locked, or after this long without touching the keyboard, mouse or trackpad.

settings.title: Sneak Peek Duration
settings.description: How long the sneak peek stays open when the extractions are over.

settings.title: Remain Visible
settings.description: How long the closed pill stays after that sneak peek. At 0 it goes away together with the sneak peek.

settings.title: Minimum Duration
settings.description: How long an extraction must take, at least, to get its pill and card. The plugin works it out from the speed, a moment after it begins. At 0 every extraction shows.
